title: Data centre electricity outlooks against metered outcomes: Ireland, the Netherlands and Great Britain (EirGrid editions 2015-2026, CSO, CBS, DESNZ, NESO FES)
description: Machine readable collection of all 11 Irish grid operator (EirGrid/SONI) demand outlook editions, 2015 to 2026, with Low, Median and High total electricity requirement by target year traced to source table and page; CSO metered data centre electricity (quarterly 2015 to 2025); CBS (Netherlands) and DESNZ (Great Britain) metered data centre electricity; NESO FES and Dutch forecast extracts; and the code and results of the accompanying paper on calibrating data centre electricity outlooks.
